effects.effect: The target takes damage equal to 3 + the condor's Might score. Additionally, enemies are [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened) while adjacent to the condor until the end of your next turn.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: An enemy who would be [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened) by this ability is [taunted](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/taunted) instead.

features.flavor: I can't draw a bead on them with that infernal bird flapping in my face!
features.name: Flurry of Wings

effects.effect: While the condor is [flying](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/fly) and has a speed greater than 0, ranged strikes against them take a bane.
